Highlights

Puritama River, giving rise to eight natural pools
The venue is equipped with dressing rooms, bathrooms and terraces.
Full description
1. Pickup in San Pedro de Atacama
Meet your guide at your hotel or designated pickup point and begin your journey to the Puritama Hot Springs.

2. Scenic Drive to Puritama
Travel through the spectacular landscapes of the Atacama Desert and the Andes while learning about the local area from your guide.

3. Arrive at Puritama Hot Springs
Explore this natural thermal oasis surrounded by mountains and desert scenery.

4. Relax in the Thermal Pools
Enjoy time to swim, soak, and relax in the warm natural waters of the Puritama thermal pools.

5. Free Time & Photography
Take in the peaceful surroundings, enjoy the scenery, and capture photos of this unique Atacama Desert destination.

6. Return to San Pedro de Atacama
After your relaxing visit, meet your guide and enjoy a comfortable return transfer to San Pedro de Atacama..
